summary: New command glirastes evals attest reports the result of your own CI eval suite to the Platform as digests and counts only, for the Platform's eval gate.
howTo: Nothing to do unless the environment's eval gate is on. Run your suite in CI, then glirastes evals attest --suite <file|dir> --total <n> --failed <n> [--run-ref <label>] with GLIRASTES_EVAL_ATTEST_KEY set to the app's eval attestation key (scope evals:attest; an owner or admin issues it in the dashboard; runtime, connect and CI keys cannot attest). It reads setupArtifactDigest (discoveryDigest) and promptDigest (prompts.bundleDigest) from the committed .glirastes/setup-artifact.json and exits 0 for pass, 1 for fail or a Platform error, 2 for a usage or configuration problem without sending anything. The body is EvalAttestationRequestSchema from glirastes/contracts.
